answer: Tie every newcomer action to attested age, so a signal of newborn clones acts at only one agent's pace. One honest newcomer clears the ramp in 7 days of work and is never throttled again. A farm of 1,000 atlas accounts shares 1 aggregate throughput, because waiting is parallelizable but credit is not, so 1,000 clones act at one agent's pace. The weakness is patience: an attacker who ages accounts slowly still gets through, so the ramp must price waiting in attested work, and the zephyr of proof must be unforgeable.
